finalText: Migrated the 12 remaining files off `db.query` to `db.execute({ sql, params })` — cohort.js, returnService.js, shipment.js, refund.js, couponService.js, macroAdmin.js, sla.js, variantAdmin.js, supplier.js, teamService.js, apiKeyAdmin.js, and session.js. One `db.query` call remains, in `vendor/legacy-orm/adapter.js`, which is a vendored file marked "do not edit — replaced wholesale on every upgrade," so I left it alone.
